placementNote: 句间留白=编辑性呼吸（durationDecision.intentionalSilence），旁白轴句区间=配音清单实测时长（v0.1 就地修订：s12 提前至 119500、总长定 124000，其余不变；未入任何收据指纹）

beats.narrationText: In the Universal Century, not every mobile suit gets to be the hero's machine.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 报丧女妖出现在战斗语境（非主角机的参战画面）

allowedVisualAlternatives: 报丧女妖持枪/射击镜头

beats.narrationText: R-X zero N, the Banshee Norn, Goddess of Fate: the Earth Federation's second answer to the riddle of the Unicorn.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 可辨认的报丧女妖·命运女神（黑金配色/金色骨架/面具造型任一组合）

beats.narrationText: Like the Unicorn, she carries a psycho-frame, armor that answers a Newtype's will.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 精神感应骨架可见（金色或发光骨架纹路）

beats.narrationText: When the N-T-D system awakens, the mask splits, the frame burns green, and a machine of order starts to look disturbingly alive.

minimumVisibleEvidence: NT-D 觉醒形态：面具展开+骨架发光（本片素材为绿色光）

beats.narrationText: Her pilot is no chosen one. Riddhe Marcenas, a Federation ace, fighting for duty rather than destiny.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 驾驶员利迪·马纳斯舱内画面（深色驾驶服/红目镜）

beats.narrationText: While Banagher rides the Unicorn toward answers, Riddhe is ordered to silence them.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 巴纳吉舱内画面（红发少年/白驾驶服）

beats.narrationText: The two machines were built as sisters. In the dark of space they do not simply fight. As the line goes: the Unicorn and the Banshee are pulling on each other.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 独角兽与报丧女妖同框对峙（白机+黑金机）

allowedVisualAlternatives: 字幕『互相牵引』台词画面

beats.narrationText: And when the psycho-frame screams, it is not a curse. It was a prayer.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 『祈愿』字幕台词画面或觉醒机体（承载该句台词证据）

beats.narrationText: Near the end, sensors report resonance beyond every measurable limit, as if countless hearts were sounding at once.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 感应波/回响语境画面（紫光人脸/白光/环绕特效+对应字幕）

beats.narrationText: She was built to bury the secret of Laplace.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 太空战斗爆焰/毁灭语境画面（『埋葬秘密』的视觉承载）

beats.narrationText: In the end, even the Federation's sharpest spear could not stop the truth being born. We were blessed when we were born.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 『被祝福着出生』字幕台词画面（利迪舱内）

beats.narrationText: The Banshee Norn: the reluctant angel of the Universal Century.

minimumVisibleEvidence: 报丧女妖 NT-D 头部大特写收尾（绿骨架+金 V 天线）
